topic: remove a scuff mark from leather shoes
core_question: How do I get a black scuff mark off a leather shoe? (secondary: How do I clean leather car seats without damaging them?)
answer_summary: Rub a plain pencil eraser briskly over the scuff mark until it lifts, then wipe the shoe clean with a soft cloth.; after the topic shift: Vacuum loose dirt, wipe the seats down with a pH-neutral, leather-specific cleaner using a soft brush or microfiber cloth, wipe off residue, and finish with a leather conditioner to protect the leather.
